Area.evidence_source: Many informants expressed guilt feelings after the suicidal act as illustrated in the following quotes: " … and I was crying because I was feeling so guilty before God. I felt so guilty … after I did that" (woman 3) and "I wish I never did what I did … but it has happened" (woman 4). The act itself was perceived as a sin which makes them consider it as a violation of the basic moral guidelines in their religious system.
